Adolion: The Adventurer's Road
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
The Journey North
At the Guild hall in Aegis City.
Wendhope lies two days north along the frontier road, and the talk on the way is the party's own.
The scene is tense.
About this story
You have just signed on at the Adventurer's Guild in Aegis City, with no party yet. Belle, a headstrong barbarian, and Dalan, a shy elf ranger, are looking for one too. The postings on the board are small, the pay is modest, and every rank has to be earned. Expect frontier fantasy with a dark edge: real danger, mysteries that open one clue at a time, and choices that cost something. Bring any adventurer you like; the Guild takes all kinds.
Recently
You left The Wendhope Job behind and moved into The Journey North.
Open threads
The Sheridan bonus hints at something worse than a collapsed mine in Wendhope.
Tobias's refusal to repeat his past mistake stands between Max and riding north today.
Tobias has pulled the Wendhope posting and refused Guild backing, so Max must either recruit Belle and Dalan or ride north unsupported.
Belle's sudden alertness at the counter raises the question of whether she will intervene or join the Loose Ends.
Belle has offered to join the Loose Ends, but the party still needs a second member before Tobias will finalize the Wendhope posting.
Following along.
Waiting for the next reply.
